title: Vision SLR® Mini Light Bar
subtitle: Compact LED mini light bar with 1-8 head configurations and multiple color options. 12 Vdc, SAE J595 Class 1 certified.
description: The Federal Signal Vision SLR® Mini Light Bar delivers flexible, high-output LED warning performance in a compact footprint. Configurable from 1 to 8 heads with a range of single- and dual-color options, it's built for police vehicles that need low-profile, purpose-built warning lighting.
summary_bullets: Non-linear design provides 360-degree light output and off-axis lighting at the critical intersection points

The Build & Configure tab will show the wrong SKU options until this is reconciled — flagged for follow-up, not fixed here per task scope.
